subject: project-nereid
label: Dense belongs to the ass and never to the tits, and the reason is anatomical
field: Nereid v8 — Handfeel jurisdiction across Pillars Two and Three
from: DENSE listed as a Handfeel value with no region restriction, mapped from the retired ANCHOR label
to: DENSE IS VALID ON ASS ONLY. Pillar Two excludes it from tit Handfeel explicitly
note:
THE RULING IS NOT A STYLE PREFERENCE. IT IS A LOAD-BEARING-MUSCLE ARGUMENT, AND IT IS THE CLEANEST PIECE OF REASONING IN EITHER PILLAR.

THE CHEEK CONTAINS SUBSTANTIAL GLUTEAL MUSCLE, FASCIA AND CONNECTIVE SUPPORT BENEATH ITS LIVING SOFTNESS. A hand meets surface yield and then genuine muscular resistance INSIDE THE ASS ITSELF. That is Dense, and it is real.

BREAST TISSUE HAS NO EQUIVALENT INTERNAL LOAD-BEARING MUSCLE BODY. Pectoral muscle supports tits FROM BENEATH AND BEHIND. It does not make the tissue Dense. So the two rulings are complementary rather than inconsistent: SUPPORT BENEATH TITS IS NOT TIT HANDFEEL; MUSCULAR SUBSTANCE INSIDE A CHEEK MAY BE ASS HANDFEEL.

AND IT IS THE PILLAR TWO FRONT LAW DOING THE WORK: NO BREAST SELECTION MAY BEHAVE LIKE AN IMPLANT DISGUISED BY BIOLOGICAL LANGUAGE. A Dense tit is an implant with a nicer word on the form. The clinic’s own test: IF A TIT KNOCKS AGAINST A DESK RATHER THAN YIELDING TO IT, THE CLINIC HAS PRODUCED EITHER AN IMPLANT OR A DISCIPLINARY PROBLEM.

WHICH LANDS ON BELLA’S RETIRED LABEL ONE MORE TIME. SHRINE-RECOIL was already caught carrying two axes in one token. The mapping PLIANT WAS SHRINE, SPRINGY WAS RECOIL, DENSE WAS ANCHOR now has a third limit on it: it is an ASS mapping, it does not translate to hips — already filed — AND IT DOES NOT TRANSLATE UPWARD EITHER. TIT HANDFEEL IS SUPPLE, PLIANT, PLUSH. Three values, and Dense is not among them.

STAFF SHOULD NOT RESOLVE THE DISTINCTION BY GRABBING BOTH REGIONS AND ANNOUNCING SEE. Unless invited. Then it remains poor terminology but acceptable peer review.
